name: KPI / Stat Cards
when_to_pick: Hand the reader 1-6 headline performance numbers at a glance — win rate, profit factor, max drawdown, average R, Sharpe. Each card shows a big value with an optional signed delta arrow and an optional short hint. Add a `spark` series to a card to draw an inline trend sparkline where the recent direction matters as much as the number. This is THE headline-numbers component (it absorbed the old key-stats grid): use point values alone for a clean stat scorecard, or add sparklines when you have a short series per metric. For a single bounded 0-100 score use gauge_meter; for many rows of attributes use comparison_table.

cards.description: One to six metric cards rendered in a responsive grid.

value.description: Headline value as a display string, e.g. '62.4%' or '+0.41R'.

delta.description: Optional change vs prior period, e.g. '+1.8 pp' or '-0.06R'. Shown next to a direction arrow.

delta_dir.description: Direction of the delta. up=improving (green/buy), down=worsening (red/sell), flat=unchanged. NOTE: meaning is direction-of-movement; for metrics where lower is better (e.g. drawdown), still set 'up' if the number rose — use the optional 'tone' to color the value if you need to flag good/bad separately.

hint.description: Optional one-line context under the value, e.g. 'Across 240 trades'.

spark.description: Optional recent values, oldest first. When present, drawn as an auto-scaled inline sparkline (6-16 points reads best). Omit for a plain point-value stat card.

tone.description: Optional semantic accent driving the sparkline color, top edge bar, and value tint. buy=green, sell=red, accent=brand blue, neutral=subtle. Defaults to following delta_dir (up=buy, down=sell, flat=neutral). Use buy/sell only for genuine directional metrics.

caption.description: Optional short caption shown under the grid, e.g. the period the figures cover.
